goal: Distinguish official HF resolve-host transport from its authenticated signed CDN with one conditional 64KiB range request; not full download or scientific experiment

legs.destination: Official SDK canonical fixed HF resolve URL
legs.authentication: Official SDK normal saved credential; bearer passed in curl stdin config only
legs.acceptance: curl0 + redirect status + exact expected x-repo-commit/x-linked-etag/x-linked-size + HTTPS official redirect host

legs.destination: HF-returned signed CDN URL in RAM only
legs.acceptance: curl0 + HTTP206 + exact content-range + exactly65536 captured body bytes + ssl_verify_result0

TLS_verification: enabled; no insecure flag or custom bypass
proxy: existing http://127.0.0.1:7897 supplied per process, no system change
SDK: isolated1.30.0 used with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 only to consume existing auth and build canonical URL
secret_retention: No token, signed URL/query, raw headers, raw stderr or model body persisted
companion_processes: Do not observe/modify/terminate CLIP or other downloads
syntax_check: ast.parse only, no model or network execution
